 Kition: the open pro suite for AI. 
 Notes, tables, boards and professional editors in one desktop workspace, edited by you and your agent.
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 Website ·
 Developers ·
 Discord ·
 Reddit ·
 X ·
 Contributing ·
 Security 
 

 
 
 

 Sixteen files, one per kit, each made with the kit's own commands and drawn by its own engine. More in Kition Showcase . 

Kition is a desktop workspace where every file opens in a real editor, and an AI agent works on
the same files with the same commands you use. A video timeline, a motion graphic, a layered
image, a slide deck, a spreadsheet, a Word document, a PDF, a note or a whiteboard: each is an
ordinary file in your workspace folder, opened by a kit , the editor for that kind of file.

The agent does not paste text back at you. It reads the file through the kit, changes it with the
kit's commands, previews the result, and runs the kit's checks. You see every change, and you can
let it work in a draft that you review before anything changes.

 Kition 0.1.1 is in beta. Keep backups of important workspaces.

 What you can do

- Open sixteen kinds of files. Videos, motion graphics, photos, vector art, page layouts,
 interface designs, documents, spreadsheets, slides, PDFs, web pages, notes, tables, boards, CAD
 drawings and 3D scenes. See Kits.
- Hand work to the agent. It edits the open file through the kit's object model, exports it to
 another file, and previews a page, a frame or a region with the kit's own renderer.
- Review before you keep. The agent can work in a draft; a write that rests on something you
 have changed since is refused instead of written over your work.
- Start from working examples. The Getting Started workspace has tables whose AI fields and
 scenarios extract, generate and summarize from each row.
- Script your workspace. A workspace script edits the open document through the kit's object
 model.

 Kits

A kit is the editor for one kind of file. Its engine is written in Rust, compiled to WebAssembly
and run in a Web Worker; the kit draws its own editor inside Kition. The agent drives the same
engine through the kit's tools, over the Kit Harness Protocol.
Every kit is open source in its own repository, and the packages Kition ships are pinned in
 kits/kits.lock.json .

 Product line Kit Edits Opens Creates 
 --- --- --- --- --- 
 Media Film Video timelines .kfilm .kfilm 
 Media Motion Motion graphics with keyframes and effects .kmotion .kmotion 
 Office Note Markdown notes, saved byte for byte .md .markdown .md 
 Office Table Tables, views and dashboards in one file .ktable .ktable 
 Office Board An infinite whiteboard for diagrams, mind maps and sketches .kboard .kboard 
 Office Doc Word-processing documents .docx .html .htm .docx 
 Office Sheet Spreadsheets with formulas .xlsx .xlsm .xltx .xltm .xls .xlt .et .ett .xlsb .ods .csv .xlsx 
 Office Slide Slides, including .pptx files .kslide .pptx .kslide 
 Office PDF Read and edit PDF files .pdf .pdf 
 Office HTML (Preview) HTML pages, with a live preview .html .htm .html 
 Design Photo Layered images, including .psd files .psd .psb .kphoto .psd 
 Design Vector Vector graphics .kvector .svg .ai .eps .kvector 
 Design Layout Page layouts: flyers, posters and books .klayout .idml .klayout 
 Design Design (Preview) Interface and screen designs .kdesign .fig .sketch .kdesign 
 Engineering CAD 2D CAD drawings .dxf .dxf 
 Engineering Scene (Preview) 3D scenes .kscene .kscene 

Kits marked Preview are early: expect gaps. To embed a kit in your own app or give it to your own
agent, see the Kition SDK and
developer.kition.ai.

 Give the kits to your agent

Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any other MCP client can use the kits without the app, through
 kition , the SDK's command line. Nothing is compiled:

 

Each kit downloads the first time the agent opens one of its files; kition kit install 
installs one ahead of time. Without installing:
 claude mcp add kition -- npx -y @kition/cli mcp --workspace "$PWD" . Without Node.js:
 curl -fsSL sh , which installs kition from npm
(registry.npmjs.org, else registry.npmmirror.com)
(Windows: irm iex ).
More in the SDK's kition guide.

 Install

Desktop builds of Kition 0.1.1 for macOS, Windows and Linux will be published on
GitHub Releases. Until then, Kition runs from
source: see CONTRIBUTING.md.

 What is in this repository

Everything that makes up the Kition desktop app:

- the React renderer ( src/ ): the workspace, the kit host, the agent, settings and scenarios;
- the Tauri desktop shell ( src-tauri/ );
- the Rust runtime ( crates/ ), which the shell runs in-process and which serves its HTTP API on
 loopback only (runtime development);
- the runtime contracts ( contracts/runtime/ ), mocks, fixtures and tests;
- the kit pins ( kits/ ) and the packaging and release workflows.

 Contributing

Issues and pull requests are welcome. How to run Kition from source, the repository layout and the
technology it uses are in CONTRIBUTING.md; the rules every change
follows are in the Kition Development Standard. Report security
issues through SECURITY.md, not a public issue.

 License

Apache-2.0 (LICENSE).
